BROTHER ARC STRUCTURE (extracted from npc.Brother.scenes, 16 scenes):

Each scene def: {id, requirements (NPC arousal/corruption/relation), requirementsMC (player corruption/exhibitionism), chance %, guide string, content-type flags (gallery/inside/blowjob/vaginal/anal/threesome/gangbang)}

TIERED GATE PATTERN:
- Tier 1 (free, intro): MC corr 0, NPC arousal 🔥. Scenes: BrotherBedroomGrope (id13), BedroomStudyBrotherGrope (id14). Trigger: visit bedroom / study. Chance 20%.
- Tier 2 (low MC corr 5-15): BrotherBedroomFlash (17), BrotherBedroomTease (18), PeepBrotherSex (20). Chance 100% — deterministic.
- Tier 3 (mid MC corr 30): SleepingBrother (16), BrotherShowerSex (19), PlayingGamesSex (22), BrotherCaughtMasturbating (24), BrotherWashDishesSex (60). Chance 20-33% — random encounters when right place + state.
- Tier 4 (high MC corr 30 + pregnancy state): BedroomStudyBrotherGropePregnant (15), PlayingGamesSexPregnant (21), BrotherBedroomPregnantSex1 (58).
- Tier 5 (direct sex, deterministic): BrotherBedroomSex1 (59) — chance 100%, MC corr 0 (likely unlocks via prior scene flag).

KEY DESIGN OBSERVATIONS FROM STRUCTURE ALONE:
1. Two scene types coexist: random encounters (chance<100) + deterministic (chance=100). RANDOM ones run on ANY visit-the-location trigger and dice-roll trigger; DETERMINISTIC are explicit menu options.
2. 'guide' field IS the Walkthrough hint UI directly.
3. Triple gating: NPC stats AND Player stats AND probability. NPC arousal uses emoji-tier (🔥 / 🔥🔥 / 🔥🔥🔥) not numeric.
4. Same player action ('Study at your room') triggers DIFFERENT scenes at different stat tiers — the player does the same mechanical thing, content escalates with state.
5. NO story prerequisites between scenes (relation always 0). The 'arc' is purely stat-threshold-based — not a narrative chain. There is no scene-A-unlocks-scene-B graph.
6. Content flags (blowjob/vaginal/anal) ARE the escalation signal. Early=all false, mid=blowjob+vaginal, no anal/threesome/gangbang in any Brother scene.
7. Pregnancy is a STATE OVERLAY (parallel scene variants), not a separate arc. Suggests pregnancy is a long-game mechanic with content branches.
8. ID gaps (13-24 then 58-60) suggest staggered content patches.

🎯 CROSS-ARC DESIGN PATTERN — domain shapes arc structure. Three distinct shapes from same scene-engine.

FAMILY ARC (Brother 16, Dad 12):
- Triggers: random encounter (20-33% chance) when at right place + stat tier met
- Gating: NPC arousal emoji-tier (🔥/🔥🔥/🔥🔥🔥) + Player corruption thresholds
- Locations: home only (Bedroom/Bathroom/Kitchen/Living)
- 'Story' mechanic: stat-threshold escalation. NO narrative prerequisites — relation requirement always 0. Same player action ('Study') → different scene at different tier.
- Player loop: visit → maybe scene → visit → maybe scene → visit → escalated scene unlocks at higher corruption.
- Reads as ambient/emergent escalation. Player isn't 'progressing a story', they're raising stats and watching content gradually escalate.

SCHOOL/PEER ARC (Marcus 5):
- Triggers: deterministic (chance=100) except MarcusClassSex (30%)
- Gating: NARRATIVE PREREQUISITES not stats. Guides cite: 'Take the test and get at least an 8 grade', 'Have at least 15 relationship points', 'wait for his invite and go to the date', 'After starting a relationship'
- Reads as traditional VN quest chain: do_quest_A → unlock_scene_B → do_quest_C → unlock_scene_D
- Player loop: read walkthrough → execute prerequisite → unlock the next deterministic beat. Discrete, planned, sequential.
- Marcus arc requires MC corruption=0 mostly — peer/school is the 'wholesome' domain.

CAREER/DIGITAL ARC (Edward 4 — Instafame):
- Triggers: deterministic, gated by external metric ('Reach 1000 followers') + WAIT TIME ('wait 10 days', 'wait 15 days')
- Phone-mediated: 'read your dm', 'read his message' — async message-driven
- Sequential chain: SecretAdmirer → SecondDate → EdwardThreesome (escalates to threesome content)
- Player loop: grind followers metric over many in-game days → wait for message → respond → date → wait again
- Reads as patient/calendar/career arc. Time-of-day rhythm and follower-count grind drive pacing.

WHY THIS MATTERS FOR DESIGN:
1. The same engine ships 3 different player loops by adjusting only chance%, requirements (stats vs flags), and where guides point.
2. Each domain creates a different EXPERIENCE: family=ambient escalation, school=quest progression, career=patient metric+wait
3. The player is doing all 3 simultaneously. Family arcs run in background while player focuses on Marcus quests or grinding Edward followers.
4. Walkthrough panel is the disambiguator — without it player wouldn't know which loop applies to which NPC.

🔑 RTS WALKTHROUGH = TRANSPARENT GAME-DESIGN REVEAL. The Walkthrough panel literally renders the scene table as data to the player:

| SCENE | NPC | REQUIREMENTS (NPC) | REQUIREMENTS (MC) | CHANCE | GUIDE | STATUS |

Same fields I extracted from npc.X.scenes data — surfaced verbatim with locked/unlocked flag. PLUS a separate location-scenes table (60+ NPC scenes + 70+ location scenes = 130+ total).

Tutorial section at top: 'At the start, you gain 1 arousal each day or after being groped. Masturbate to raise corruption. At 5 corruption you unlock flash. Some events need stat thresholds, some need visiting locations.' = the bootstrap loop is taught explicitly.

DESIGN IMPLICATION:
- RTS does NOT obscure its mechanics. The walkthrough IS the planning UI.
- Player's actual loop: Open Walkthrough → pick a locked scene that's close to unlocked → identify the gap (e.g. 'need MC corr 30, currently 18') → grind → re-attempt → unlock → check off list.
- There is NO discovery-of-the-unknown. The narrative is 'achieve the listed scenes' — a content checklist.
- This is fundamentally different from a hidden-progression VN. RTS sells the mechanical scaffold AS the game.

This explains why Marcus arc (5 scenes, deterministic) and Brother arc (15, random) coexist without confusion: the walkthrough disambiguates per-scene.

🎮 PASSAGE-LEVEL MECHANICS observed in BrotherBedroom + Bedroom passage source:

1. SOFT-FAIL vs NOTIFY-FAIL on gated buttons:
   - Tease/Flash buttons: silently do nothing if reqs not met (no UI feedback)
   - 'Have sex' button: shows notification ('Am I crazy? Not doing that with my Stepbrother') AND raises corruption via <<NotifyCorruption 4>>
   - PATTERN: Failing taboo actions IS itself a progression mechanic. The player presses 'no' → game says 'no' → corruption +4. Rejection trains the player.

2. RANDOM ENCOUNTERS gated by previous-passage:
   <<if previous() == 'Hallway' && (NPC.arousal > 0 && IsNpcAtHome)>>
     <<if random(1,2) == 1>> goto Grope
     <<if random(1,3) == 1 && Brother.corruption >= 10 && !Josh.SellingMyStepsister.unlocked>> goto SellingMyStepsister
   - Encounters fire on TRANSITION (entering room from hub), not on dwell.
   - 'previous() == Hallway' check prevents loop-spam by retrying same room.
   - Multiple scenes roll in sequence — first hit wins.
   - !executedToday flag enforces once-per-day cap.

3. CROSS-NPC SCENE BRANCHING:
   - SellingMyStepsister gates on Brother.corruption >= 10 + Josh scene NOT unlocked.
   - Once unlocked, this scene transfers Brother arc INTO Josh arc.
   - NPC arcs are linked via scene-flag dependencies, not just stat thresholds.

4. PROGRESSIVE UNLOCK BUTTONS in player room:
   - Masturbate button only shows after isPurchased('phone')
   - Laptop button only after isPurchased('laptop')
   - Do-homework button only when quest active + homework not done
   - Hallway-button blocked if naked + corruption < 30 (with notification text exposing the threshold)
   - PATTERN: Room layout EVOLVES with player progression. New affordances literally appear.

5. CLOTHING-LEVEL GATING with notification:
   - 'I should wear some clothes.. 30+ Corruption Needed'
   - The MESSAGE TELLS the player exactly what's needed. No hidden gate.
   - Same transparency principle as the Walkthrough panel.

6. TIME-OF-DAY GATING:
   - LN (late night): Sleep button enabled, Study disabled, +Sleep with him option in Brother bedroom if relation>=10
   - Same room, different button set per time bucket. Time = SECOND content axis after stats.

🧭 SYNTHESIS — How RTS designs the story+mechanics player experience.

THE CORE GAME LOOP (what the player actually does):
1. Open Walkthrough panel (transparent scene table). 
2. Pick a locked scene close to unlocking — read its requirements (NPC stats / MC stats / location / time-of-day) and 'GUIDE' string.
3. Execute mechanic to close the gap: study (raise intel), masturbate (raise corruption), wear slutty clothes (raise exhibitionism), grind followers, work shifts (money), etc.
4. Travel to required location at required time, attempt the action.
5. Either: (a) deterministic scene fires, content unlocks, gallery thumbnail appears, OR (b) chance roll fails — retry tomorrow OR (c) requirements still not met → soft fail → try a different action.
6. Return to Walkthrough — verify scene now Unlocked. Pick next.

WHAT THE 'STORY' IS:
- Not narrative throughlines per NPC. There are NO plot beats that escalate emotionally over time.
- The 'story' is the playerʼs SELF-AUTHORED checklist progression — collecting unlocks across the 130+ scene table.
- Each scene is a mini-vignette (image/video + dialogue) that plays once, then becomes a Gallery entry.
- Continuity comes from STATS RISING (corruption goes from Pure → Lewd → Slutty → Whore as visible level) + WORLD UNLOCKS (jobs, apartment, car, social media followers, gym membership) — not from character development arcs.

THREE PARALLEL ARC SHAPES (same engine, different player loops):
1. FAMILY ARC (Brother 16, Dad 12, Grandpa 6): RANDOM-ENCOUNTER + AMBIENT ESCALATION. Triple-gated (NPC arousal tier emoji + Player corruption + dice roll on entry). Locations: home only. Player loop: visit room → maybe scene fires → repeat. Very low effort, high frequency, content escalates with corruption tier. Bootstrap: flash/tease (corruption 5+) at 100% chance to raise NPC arousal — once arousal>0, random encounters become possible.
2. PEER/SCHOOL ARC (Marcus 5): DETERMINISTIC QUEST CHAIN. 100% chance scenes gated by NARRATIVE PREREQUISITES ('get test grade ≥ 8', 'reach 15 relation', 'wait for invite', 'after starting relationship'). Reads as traditional VN. Player loop: read walkthrough → execute discrete prerequisite → unlock next deterministic beat. MC corruption requirement = 0 mostly — peer/school is the 'wholesome' track.
3. CAREER/DIGITAL ARC (Edward 4 — Instafame): METRIC-GATED + TIME-DELAYED. 'Reach 1000 followers + read DM' → 'wait 10 days, read message' → 'wait 15 days, read message'. Phone-mediated, async, calendar-driven. Player loop: grind external metric over many in-game days → wait for messages → respond → date.

WHY THIS WORKS AS DESIGN:
- The 3 arc shapes give DIFFERENT TEMPOS so the player isn't doing the same thing always. Family runs in background passively; peer is what you focus on this session; career is the long-burn project across weeks.
- The walkthrough panel + sidebar quest tracker keep all 3 visible simultaneously without UI overload.
- All scenes share the SAME engine (npc.X.scenes data + checkSceneReq()) — content authoring is consistent, only the requirements differ.
- Bootstrap loops (notify-fail-raises-corruption, +1-arousal-per-day, masturbate-raises-corruption) ensure the player is never stuck — even rejection is progress.

REWARD STRUCTURE PER BEAT:
- Mini-vignette plays (image grid or short video, dialogue)
- Gallery entry unlocks (rewatchable)
- Sometimes: stat changes (relation +1, NPC corruption +5)
- Sometimes: world unlocks (new shop, new location, new clothing item)
- Always: walkthrough table updates 🔒 → ✅ — the checklist itself is the reward UI

REWARD STRUCTURE PER ARC:
- No 'arc ending'. There is no scene N that closes Brother's story. The 16th unlock just adds another vignette to gallery.
- The game's 'ending' is implicitly: collect every unlock, see every Gallery, max every stat. Open-ended sandbox progression.
- This is RTS's signature: it ships content as inventory, not as plot.

IMPLICATIONS FOR THE LONG SUMMER (TLS test slice):
- TLS already adopted the right structural primitives: triple gating (NPC stats / MC stats / chance), per-NPC scene tables, walkthrough/quest panel, time-of-day buckets.
- TLS's stage_npc/stage_op/stage_value approach is a HYBRID: it adds the narrative-stage axis Marcus has (peer arc with explicit beat ordering) on top of the stat-tier axis Brother has. This is good — it gives authors both modes.
- TLS RISKS: if every NPC follows the family-arc pattern (random encounters with ambient escalation), the experience reads as 'grindy' vs 'storytold'. If every NPC follows the peer-arc pattern (sequential scene chain), it reads as 'visual novel' not 'sandbox'. Use the 3-shape mix per RTS.
- TLS HINT TEMPLATES with priority overrides (rent crisis variant) are a SOPHISTICATION OVER RTS — RTS walkthrough is static; TLS hints can swap based on world-state. This is a real improvement.
- The 'NotifyCorruption on rejection' loop is missing from TLS — worth adding: failing a corruption-gated action raises corruption itself. Makes early game less stuck-feeling.
